correctness.rationale: Lemmas 1–3 establish necessary and sufficient sensor classification for all m,n>=3 via explicit initial unseen sets and one-round forces, with all boundary dimensions. Disjoint failure types prove polynomial and sharp extrema. Exact Bernoulli counting proves both limits. The actual standalone graph simulator exhaustively tests 1,184,250 subsets in six graphs plus larger cardinality slices; all agreed.

value.rationale: The result determines the full size-spectrum and sharp universal placement guarantee of a natural two-parameter family, not only its previously known scalar minimum. All failed configurations and propagation times are structurally classified. The fixed-width and growing-two-width sparse random sensor limits differ and quantify reliability in a way unavailable from scalar power domination or ordinary/total domination.
